_comment: Azure Static Web Apps deployment config. The headers below harden the app (CSP confining scripts/styles/images to this origin plus the standard set). Auth strategy: the durable session is an httpOnly cookie; add SWA route(s) proxying /api/* to the Container App so the API is same-origin — cookies then stay first-party (no third-party-cookie dependence). 'unsafe-inline' on script-src/style-src is required because a pure static export cannot inject per-response nonces into Next's inline hydration payloads and style attributes. connect-src allows https: and localhost because NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL is a build-time variable pointing at the VeriPay API origin — tighten it to that exact origin when it is known.

/*.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' http://localhost:* https:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'
